project_info.application_name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Management System
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier architecture with external charging stations connecting through Network Load Balancer to ECS on Fargate. Internal microservices communicate through Application Load Balancer. Web application served via CloudFront CDN with API Gateway backend. Clear separation between public-facing components and internal microservices with load balancing at multiple layers.
